title: FSM Missing Default — Latch Inferred on next_state
description: The case statement covers IDLE and BUSY but assigns next_state only inside nested if conditions; when the conditions are false next_state is undriven, causing synthesis to infer a latch.
bug_signature: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'next_state' in always_comb; start=0/done=0 paths leave next_state undriven
expected_root_cause: The always_comb case statement has no default assignment for next_state before the case block, and the conditional assignments inside each branch leave next_state undriven when start=0 or done=0, causing synthesis to infer a latch.
expected_fix_contains: next_state = state;  // Default: hold current state
rtl:
always_comb begin
  case (state)
    IDLE: if (start) next_state = BUSY;  // Undriven when start=0
    BUSY: if (done)  next_state = IDLE;  // Undriven when done=0
  endcase
end
failure_log: VCS-WARNING: Latch inferred for 'next_state' in always_comb; start=0/done=0 paths leave next_state undriven
success_log: No latch warnings. next_state driven on all paths.
